page.content:
Hot-headed Toa of Fire and the first BIONICLE hero many kids built.

How Tahu connects

  • Work: BIONICLE — Tahu is the Toa of Fire at the start of the BIONICLE story.
  • Location: Mata Nui — Tahu first walks the island of Mata Nui as a Toa of Fire.

What is Tahu?

Tahu is the Toa of Fire on Mata Nui, the red canister set whose mask, blades, and temper opened the BIONICLE story of six Toa gathering to wake the Great Spirit.

Key threads lead to BIONICLE and Mata Nui.
